body: `{` should be covered by brace-style, however that's configured.
For those of us who don't enforce braces, the "fix" to #3198 totally broke this rule with `else`.
Yeah, seems like this is the wrong warning. Really, we shouldn't warn about a newline at all, we should just ignore it.
Wouldn't that just revert to the pre-#3198 behavior?
Not exactly. If a space is expected but a newline is found, that seems like it should be an error?
It seems to me that `else` should just be excluded from this rule, no? You always have to have a space of some sort after else don't you?
Oh, unless it's a brace, but @btmills you [seemed to indicate](https://github.com/eslint/eslint/issues/3226#issuecomment-126799575) that should be covered by other rules.
Braces on new lines (or not) are covered, but not the space between else and the brace
